fields.name: slot_header_reserved
fields.evidence: All-zero in both .sav samples at slot offsets 0x0000/0x0D00/0x1A00/0x2700 +0x00..0xBF

fields.name: slot_marker_a
fields.evidence: Bytes 60 60 at 0x00C0,0x0DC0,0x1AC0,0x27C0 and again at +0xC00 block in both samples

fields.name: slot_flag_byte
fields.evidence: Byte 0x02 at 0x00F9 (+replicas) and 0x0CF9 (+replicas); surrounding bytes zero

fields.name: slot_flags_array
fields.evidence: 64 identical 8-byte records at slot+0x100..0x2FF in both samples; no code in decompiled set indexes it

fields.name: slot_records_array
fields.evidence: Record stride 0x18 verified by repeating u32=4 header at slot+0x300+0x18*n; no decompiled function references the RAM mirror, so gameplay meaning is inferred from value shape only

fields.name: trailer_magic
fields.evidence: ASCII at 0x3400 in both .sav; FUN_086d26f4 compares 4 int words after SRAM read (decompiled.c:1888-1895)

fields.name: trailer_variable_byte
fields.evidence: 3-byte diff between samples is exactly this byte plus the 2 resulting checksum bytes

fields.name: trailer_checksum
fields.evidence: sum8 over [0,0x341C) equals stored u32 LE on both samples (see report Sec.4)

fields.name: unused_sram_tail
fields.evidence: Both 32768-byte samples are 0xFF from 0x3420 onward; writer length is total-4 covered +4 checksum = 0x3420
